messages:
devin: New idea: "dynamic overage escrow" to give customers short-term overage flexibility without immediate billing sticker shock. brown-field for pilot?
sana: explain the flow quickly pls.
mike: sketch: customer hits commit + buffer. overages during window go into an escrow account instead of immediate invoice. at month end we reconcile: small net overages get forgiven up to X, larger get billed or converted to next-month buffer.
rachel: sales POV: this is interesting for finance teams that hate surprise invoices. question: how do we price escrow forgiveness?
devin: propose rule: escrow forgiveness cap = min(10% of commit, $5k) per month for pilot. forgiveness = one-time waiver, not recurring.
sana: legal ask: need contract language for refundable vs nonrefundable escrow funds and clawback timeline. also anti-abuse terms.
mike: infra/billing: implement escrow ledger, escrow balance per account, reconciliation job at EOM. estimate: 2 backend sprints + 1 billing sprint.
rachel: customer UX: console shows escrow balance, projected forgiveness, and an opt-in toggle. default opt-in off for pilot.
devin: launch criteria (pilot): 1) escrow ledger + reconcile job, 2) console display + opt-in, 3) T&Cs and abuse definition, 4) finance approval for forgiveness cap.
sana: KPIs: number of opt-ins, avg escrow forgiveness per account, churn impact, CS ticket volume, and billing disputes.
mike: ops safety: hard cap = 3x daily peak; exceed goes to immediate billing and flagged for review.
rachel: migration: allow burst-credit customers to try escrow for 60d with pro-rated conversion.
devin: sales asks: 1) allow a single trial forgiveness for new logos, 2) enable reporting for CFOs.
sana: risk: complexity in accounting and potential revenue timing shifts. mitigation: pilot only 10 customers, finance close monitoring.
devin: next steps: rachel shortlist 10 pilot candidates; mike scope tickets; i'll draft pricing/forgiveness table by Thu. @pricing-bot create epic. :rocket:
pricing-bot: Created epic PRIC-ESCROW (https://go/repo/PRIC-ESCROW) - owners: devin, mike, sana.
